row_projection.scenario: The exact 29-entry closed mutation catalog reproduces catalog digest 70e25071c072320510da0f2176c660e3bf52f824628485c1f1d220f35c421dc2 and binds only frozen stage-8 through stage-13 negative rows.
The builder applies exactly one catalog mutation, preserves the mutated target bytes, changes only the target plus declared derived outer authority fields, and reproduces the closed proof digests.
A correctly resealed cataloged stage-8 semantic mutation passes authority integrity and the unchanged public entrypoint rejects at its exact stage-8 code and path.
A correctly resealed cataloged stage-9 semantic mutation passes authority integrity and the unchanged public entrypoint rejects at its exact stage-9 code and path.
A correctly resealed cataloged scenario mutation passes authority integrity and the unchanged public entrypoint rejects at its exact stage-10 code and path.
A correctly resealed cataloged witness or digest mutation passes authority integrity and the unchanged public entrypoint rejects at its exact stage-11 code and path.
A correctly resealed cataloged warning mutation passes authority integrity and the unchanged public entrypoint rejects at its exact stage-12 code and path.
A correctly resealed cataloged terminal mutation passes authority integrity and the unchanged public entrypoint rejects at its exact stage-13 code and path.
A cataloged semantic mutation with the original or any stale contribution, artifact, transport, catalog, scenario or aggregate digest is rejected at stage 6 before its semantic oracle.
A missing, partial, reordered, mixed-generation, unknown-field or non-JCS outer reseal chain is rejected at stage 6.
The builder rejects any operation that changes, normalizes or restores the target semantic defect during outer resealing.
Two or more non-derived semantic differences from the frozen baseline are not a canonical negative authority and are rejected at stage 6.
A mutation absent from the exact catalog or with an unknown identity, kind, target, source, operand or oracle is rejected at stage 6.
A wrapper, proof-bearing validator input, hidden flag, alternate authority, stage skip or test-only admission representation is rejected and cannot call later stages.
When a correctly cataloged stage-8 semantic defect is combined with a stale or malformed outer authority, stage 6 wins and the stage-8 oracle is not evaluated.
When a stage-13 terminal defect is combined with a stage-8 port or catalog defect, stage 8 wins and later-stage oracles are not evaluated.
A mutation whose row, source pointer, target pointer, operand, expected stage, code or path differs from its catalog identity is rejected at stage 6.
URL refetch, fixture substitution, runtime reconstruction, environmental input, alternate baseline or implicit fallback cannot supply mutation or reseal authority.
If a cataloged negative mutation unexpectedly survives its declared semantic stage, the unchanged public entrypoint rejects final seal at stage 14 and never returns completion.
Normative rows must invoke the same exported public production entrypoint; alternate validators, direct stage calls and test-only validation branches are forbidden.
